messages:
Priya Nair: Quick sync: PartnerEdge wants to list across AWS/GCP/Azure. We need a single artifact policy doc outlining AMI vs container requirements, SBOM, image signing, and trial mapping. Who can draft?
Diego Morales: I can start the artifact checklist. Key diffs: AWS requires AMI manifest + account permissions; GCP wants container image + Marketplace Listing YAML; Azure needs ACR import and managed image metadata.
Lena Cho: Security items first: SBOM (CycloneDX), image signatures (cosign), vulnerability scan report (trivy or Aqua), and KMS key ownership declared. Also confirm whether models included trigger export control.
Ethan Brooks: Product: trial flow must be identical across clouds — 14-day seat-based trial, auto-convert to paid with metering tag. Need billing SKU name consistent: partneredge-seat.
Diego Morales: Draft snippet for GCP listing YAML (very small):
```yaml
name: partneredge-container
sku: partneredge-seat-trial
trial_days: 14
artifacts:
  - type: container
    image: gcr.io/partneredge/partneredge:stable-2026-03
```
Diego Morales: AWS AMI metadata example (JSON):
```json
{"ami_name":"partneredge-2026-03","sbom":"s3://rwd-sec/sboms/partneredge-2026-03.cdx.json","signed_by":"partneredge-cosign"}
```
Lena Cho: Ops/security: we need the SBOM URL to be accessible to our marketplace ingestion bot (read-only). Add policy: expire presigned URLs after 72h if hosted in partner S3.
Priya Nair: Partner says they will host artifacts in their accounts and provide read-only links. They require a runbook for marketplace ingestion steps. Can we publish a minimal runbook?
Diego Morales: Yes. Packer for AMI + Dockerfile + gcloud build.yaml + az acr import command. Example az import: `az acr import -n RedwoodRegistry --source dockerhub.com/partneredge/partneredge:stable`
Ethan Brooks: Also capture support/contact mapping for listing: partner support email, our marketplace support alias, and escalation path. We need SLAs for initial 30 days after launch.
Lena Cho: Legal note: include license provenance for model weights. If weights are third-party, include attribution and license file in SBOM. I'll add to the compliance checklist.
partner-bot: Artifact policy draft created: https://rwd/internal/marketplace/artifact-policy/partneredge-1809991234 (created by Diego Morales) :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: Great. Diego, can you include a sample cosign key provisioning note and command?
Diego Morales: Cosign example: `cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/secrets/cosign/partneredge keyless` (we'll adapt if partner uses keyless). I'll include verification snippet for ingestion pipeline.
Ethan Brooks: UX detail: marketplace listing description should mention trial terms, region availability, and data residency. Ask PartnerEdge for preferred regions.
Priya Nair: I'll request region list and legal contact. Lena, can security provide the exact SBOM schema we require?
Lena Cho: CycloneDX 1.4 JSON required. Fields: components, licenses, hashes. I'll paste a minimal template into the doc.
Diego Morales: I'll open a PR with: TF module updates, manifest templates for each cloud, and a small runbook. Tagging `@ops` and `@devex` for review.
Priya Nair: Timeline: need signed DPA + EULA redline + artifact proofs before we submit to AWS. Target to submit next Thursday.
Ethan Brooks: I'll coordinate the launch checklist and marketing blurb once listing is live.
partner-bot: Calendar invite created for 1809994800 (review meeting): https://rwd/calendar/1809994800
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — Diego, drop the PR link here when ready and I'll loop PartnerEdge. :pray:
